Package com.bilt.pos.media.service

Class ActionOutcome

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.media.service.ActionOutcome
public final class ActionOutcome extends Object
The platform's answer to a tapped call to action.

Three shapes, told apart by isAccepted() and getOffer(): an APPLY_OFFER the platform honours is accepted with an offer for the register to apply; any other accepted action (SEND_TO_PHONE, DETAILS, DISMISS) is accepted without one; and a token the platform does not recognise, has already redeemed, or considers expired is rejected with a reason meant for logs, not for the shopper.
